jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Passion fruit (purple) manual

varieties.name: Purple (KPF11)
varieties.supplier_notes: KALRO-released; main commercial purple; grafted on yellow rootstock.

timeline_template.description_en: Erect 2m trellis posts every 5m, with 3 wires at 0.6m / 1.2m / 2m. Mandatory — passion is a vine.
timeline_template.description_sw: Simika nguzo 2m kila 5m, na waya 3. Lazima — pasheni ni mzabibu.

timeline_template.description_en: Dig 45cm holes at 3m x 2m spacing. Mix soil + manure.
Plant grafted seedling. Tie main shoot to trellis as it grows.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mche. Funga shina kwenye trellis.

timeline_template.description_en: Train single shoot up to top wire. Remove all side shoots until then.
timeline_template.description_sw: Ongoza shina moja juu hadi waya wa juu. Ondoa matawi mengine.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut growing tip at top wire to force 2 laterals.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata kichwa cha shina ukifika waya wa juu kuongeza matawi 2.
Weka gramu 250 za NPK kwa mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Second NPK dose at first flowering.
timeline_template.description_sw: NPK ya pili wakati wa maua ya kwanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for fruit fly + brown spot every 4 weeks during fruiting.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya fruit fly + brown spot kila wiki 4.

timeline_template.description_en: First fruits 9 months after transplant. Pick when fully purple; some drop is normal.
timeline_template.description_sw: Matunda ya kwanza miezi 9. Vuna yakiwa zambarau.
timeline_template.tip_en: Collect drops daily — they're as good as picked. Don't let them rot.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Okota yale yaliyoanguka kila siku — ni mazuri vivyo hivyo.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant peaks at month 18; produces 2-3 years total before rebuilding.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mavuno ya juu mwezi 18; mmea hutoa miaka 2-3.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: 60g+, smooth skin, fully purple. Grade B: 40-60g or shriveled.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: 10-13°C extends shelf life to 3 weeks. Room temp: 1 week.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pin-prick stings on ripening fruit, larvae inside, premature drop.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kuchomwa kwenye matunda yanayoiva, viluwiluwi ndani, kuanguka mapema.
diseases.treatment_en: Spinosad protein bait sprays; orchard sanitation. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za chambo za spinosad; usafi wa shamba. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Brown circular spots on leaves, yellow halo, leaf drop, blemished fruit in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia mviringo majani, mpaka wa manjano, majani kuanguka, mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Mancozeb-class at first spots; prune for airflow. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za mancozeb mara madoa yanapoanza; kata matawi kwa hewa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kata matawi, hewa kwenye trellis, ondoa mabaki.
diseases.scanner_notes: Circular spots with halos vs powdery mildew dusting.

diseases.symptoms_en: Mottled leaves, woody malformed fruit with thickened rind, stunted vines.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yenye madoa, matunda magumu yaliyopinda, mizabibu dhaifu.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue infected vines immediately; aphid control only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa mizabibu iliyoathirika mara moja; dhibiti vidukari tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean certified seedlings, aphid management, never take cuttings from infected vines.
diseases.prevention_sw: Miche safi, dhibiti vidukari, usichukue vipandikizi kutoka mimea iliyoathirika.
diseases.scanner_notes: Hard woody fruit + mottled leaves = PWV, not nutrient deficiency.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellowing from older leaves, brown vascular ring in cut stems, wilt.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kuwitikia kuanzia majani makubwa, pete ya kahawia kwenye shina, kunyauka.
diseases.treatment_en: None — remove and destroy; resistant varieties where available. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ondoa na uteketeze; aina sugu zilizopo. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotation, clean planting material, solarize beds.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha, miche safi, weka jua kwenye vitanda.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-stem ring + wilt = fusarium vs bacterial wilt's ooze.

diseases.symptoms_en: Dark lesions at the vine collar, wilting vines, fruit rot in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Vidonda vyeusi kwenye shina, mizabibu kunyauka, matunda kuoza mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Metalaxyl-class collar drench at first symptoms. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za metalaxyl kwenye shina mara dalili zinapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Perfect drainage, raised beds, no collar watering.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mifereji bora, vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, usimwagilie shina.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the vine base — collar lesions are the signature.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Premium fruit, year-round bearing with peaks in dry spells. Export and juice channels pay for clean fruit.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Tunda la bei ya juu, huzaa mwaka mzima na kilele kiangazi. Soko la nje hulipa matunda safi.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 50–150 KES per kg by grade (November 2026). Clean seedlings + the PWV plan decide the orchard.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 50–150 kwa kilo kwa daraja (Novemba 2026). Miche safi + mpango wa PWV ndio huamua shamba.
